jobs.description: sizeless builds the data layer for physical AI in construction. Contractors film an open trench with a smartphone. The same data is the foundation for training the robots that will one day work on construction sites.  It is a real problem with real customers: construction and utilities still document reality by hand, and almost nothing about that process has changed in decades.
